procedure_name: Testing and Replacement of Faulty Water Meter
summary: Official laboratory accuracy testing of water meters reporting excessively high readings.
estimated_total_cost: ₹150 testing fee (Refunded if meter found defective)

steps.title: Lodge excessive billing complaint
steps.description: Register dispute citing previous 3 billing cycles on water portal.

steps.title: Pay lab test deposit
steps.description: Deposit standard laboratory testing fee at municipal cash counter.

steps.title: Meter removal under seal
steps.description: Municipal plumber visits site, disconnects meter in presence of consumer, and applies tamper seal.

steps.title: Laboratory flow calibration test
steps.description: Meter tested at test bench across slow, medium, and high flow rates.

steps.title: Replacement and bill adjustment
steps.description: If error > 5%, meter replaced with calibrated unit and excess billing adjusted in next bill cycle.
